items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Him and Buddy Doris. Guitar players in the car.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. You recorded Roland and Tomlin as Delta Joe. Yes. Oh, yes. Where did you get that number from? Where did you learn it? Roland and Tomlin? Yeah.

That's just like I made going back to Memphis. That's Roland and Tomlin still. Highway 61 I made is going back. It's still Roland and Tomlin. It's the same suit. It's just a different song. They got it copyrighted. I just whooped it around. After I woke it up, Memphis Nell told me playing the number. You see, I know Memphis Nell wasn't nowhere originated around when Roland and Tomlin came across in 1924. No. I know when Memphis Nell started. Yeah. He was still in North Memphis up there about the North Memphis case.
